headline: 4 arrested after crude bombs explode outside ICT judge’s home
summary: Several devices were thrown at the residence of International Crimes Tribunal-2 judge Manjurul Bashid in Dhanmondi shortly before Friday prayers.
details: Several crude bombs exploded outside the Dhanmondi home of judge Manjurul Bashid, a judge of the International Crimes Tribunal-2.
The blasts occurred shortly before Friday prayers, prompting a rapid response from police and the Bomb Disposal Unit.
According to Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam, four to five crude bombs exploded, while three more unexploded devices were recovered and rendered harmless.
Four suspects were arrested with the help of local residents while they were attempting to flee the scene.
A relative of the judge provided a different account, stating that three bombs were thrown, two of which exploded and one did not.
The Bomb Disposal Unit confirmed they rushed to the scene upon receiving the report and safely defused the remaining unexploded devices.
caption:
Crude bombs targeted the home of an ICT-2 judge in Dhanmondi. Four suspects were arrested while fleeing.

Several crude bombs exploded outside the Dhanmondi home of judge Manjurul Bashid, a judge of the International Crimes Tribunal-2.

The blasts occurred shortly before Friday prayers, prompting a rapid response from police and the Bomb Disposal Unit.

According to Ramna Division Deputy Commissioner Sheikh Zahidul Islam, four to five crude bombs exploded, while three more unexploded devices were recovered and rendered harmless.

Four suspects were arrested with the help of local residents while they were attempting to flee the scene.

A relative of the judge provided a different account, stating that three bombs were thrown, two of which exploded and one did not.

The Bomb Disposal Unit confirmed they rushed to the scene upon receiving the report and safely defused the remaining unexploded devices.
